doc.headline: Run Brisk-S with low reasoning and one retry: it is the cheapest of five configurations that clear the {criteria.pass_rate.threshold} pass-rate gate, but by only {criteria.pass_rate.brisk-s.low.r1.gap} points.
doc.lede: It costs {cost_per_1k.brisk-s.low.r1} per 1k calls against {cost_per_1k.atlas-m.low.r1} for the next Atlas-M option. Its clearance is thin: a fresh run of this size reads the other way {settle.criteria.pass_rate.brisk-s.low.r1.overall.wrong_side} of the time.

caveats.material_if: the true pass rate of Brisk-S low reasoning with one retry sits below the gate; its clearance is only {criteria.pass_rate.brisk-s.low.r1.gap} points and no interval is stated
the pick's lead is mostly luck of choosing the best of {n_candidates} configurations; a re-run would likely read it lower
a claim that one configuration beats another is made from figures alone, since nothing was read paired

decision.text: Adopt Brisk-S, reasoning low, one retry. It passes at {criteria.pass_rate.brisk-s.low.r1.value} and is not dominated by any option.

Atlas-M low with one retry passes at a higher cost of {cost_per_1k.atlas-m.low.r1}; Brisk-S high with one retry costs {cost_per_1k.brisk-s.high.r1}. Every Nano-XS configuration misses the gate, the best at {criteria.pass_rate.nano-xs.high.r1.value}.

The clearance is {criteria.pass_rate.brisk-s.low.r1.gap} points on a point estimate; the wrong-side risk is {settle.criteria.pass_rate.brisk-s.low.r1.overall.wrong_side}. Brisk-S high with one retry clears by {criteria.pass_rate.brisk-s.high.r1.gap} points at about twice the cost.
Re-run the two Brisk-S retry configurations on fresh cases; settling the thin clearance needs about {settle.criteria.pass_rate.brisk-s.low.r1.overall.cases_needed_two_sided_80} cases.

claims.text: Five of eighteen configurations clear the pass-rate gate, and Brisk-S low with one retry is the cheapest.

evidence.caption: Cost per 1k calls of the five configurations that pass the gate.

claims.text: Nano-XS misses the gate in every configuration, so its low price does not help.

omitted.why: No latency budget was declared; they do not change the gate call.

next.text: Re-run on fresh cases at the {settle.criteria.pass_rate.brisk-s.low.r1.overall.cases_needed_two_sided_80}-case size.
next.settles: whether Brisk-S low with one retry truly clears the gate.

method.text: Pass rate is the share of cases passing, gated at {criteria.pass_rate.threshold}; no control was declared.
